Disclosure to Promote the Right To Information 

Whereas the Parliament of India has set out to provide a practical regime of right to 
information for citizens to secure access to information under the control of public authorities, 
in order to promote transparency and accountability in the working of every public authority, 
and whereas the attached publication of the Bureau of Indian Standards is of particular interest 
to the public, particularly disadvantaged communities and those engaged in the pursuit of 
education and knowledge, the attached public safety standard is made available to promote the 
timely dissemination of this information in an accurate manner to the public.

EXPLANATORY NOTE 

This standard was first published in 1980. Subsequently, the increased usage of feed pumps 
with flat follower as well as pin drive type required standardization. In this revision, these types 
have also been incorporated. The working pressure of the feed pumps is also restricted to 
1-5±0*5kgf/cm 2 . 

The other parts of this standard are as follows: 
Part 2 Types of drive 
Part 3 Testing and performance requirements (under preparation) 

In the preparation of this standard, assistance has been derived from DIN 73356 'Kraffstoff- 
Forderpumpen Zum Ambau an Einspiritzpumper oder Disselmotor', issued by the Deutsches Institut 
fur Normung, Germany (DIN). 

Indian standards for fuel pump levers, injectors, couplings, bench test procedures, etc, are 
under preparation. 



Printed at Printograph, New Delhi, India
